shape_construction: Believable task-specific proportions, silhouettes, construction, joins and object anatomy. Generic boxes, disconnected pipes, floating parts and unclosed architectural gaps are substantive defects. Judge intended stylization, not polygon count.
materials: Appropriate authored material vocabulary, scale, surface differentiation and consistency. Default/checker surfaces, indiscriminate tiling and texture pasted over primitive geometry do not establish finish. Do not demand wear where not requested.
lighting: Exposure, readable surfaces, shadow depth, light/material relationships across all important zones. Burnt-out whites, persistent darkness, flat unreadable surfaces and pervasive glare lower quality even if objects exist.
composition: Spatial hierarchy, focal readability, coherent massing and purposeful distribution at overview, street/room and close scales. Empty space is not inherently bad; unjustified barren requested working or inhabited zones are.
detail: Meaningful task-specific equipment, furnishing and environmental detail at large/medium/small scales. Repeated colored boxes, labels and token props cannot stand in for differentiated functional objects or rich requested spaces.
style: Match the requested/reference visual language across all zones. Real environments require plausible construction and material treatment; voxel/game styles require intentional resolved abstraction. Do not penalize coherent low-poly/voxel design for not being photorealistic.
scene_coverage: Substantive realization of the public brief and reference scene extent, connected zones, context and principal architectural/environmental features. Judge the realized scene, not merely presence counts or labels. Avoid requiring identical camera or incidental photograph clutter.
functional_identity: Visible differentiation and credible furnishing of required functional areas and mechanisms. A named room with token objects is partial credit. Compare defining reference features when supplied. Do not infer actual interactive success from appearance.

formula: continuous quality anchored to visible completion; coverage and deviation retained separately as diagnostics

environment.criterion: Preserve the enclosure of pedestrian spaces by closely spaced multistorey buildings, with narrow gaps revealing additional architecture and the distant bell tower.
Maintain pedestrian scale through doors, shallow steps, balconies, benches and canal posts; surrounding buildings rise several storeys above these elements.
Match the warm coral, ochre and cream architecture, terracotta roofs, green shutters, blue accents and dark teal canal water, with clearly separated stylized materials.
Use bright warm daylight, a cyan sky with soft pale clouds, strong directional shadows and restrained surface weathering consistent with the sunny references.

features.criterion: A low canal-front shop row sits beside a taller coral building, producing a stepped roofline along the water.
Broad green shop awnings include a raised curved central section above large glazed frontage.
Upper windows have dark green shutters and pale surrounds; the taller facade includes a triple-arched window with flowers.
Terracotta tiled roofs, projecting eaves and tall chimney pots articulate the upper silhouette.
Exposed red brick and muted coral plaster contrast with pale stone bands and dark storefront glazing.

targets.label: Canal-front shops and adjoining coral residence

features.criterion: A tall coral corner building dominates the raised plaza, with two visible facades and a broad projecting roof cornice.
Stacked rectangular windows combine green shutters, pale stone frames and shallow balconies with dark metal railings.
The ground storey forms a substantial exposed-brick base separated from upper plaster by a continuous pale band.
Coral plaster has irregular pale worn patches; flower boxes and climbing foliage punctuate the window grid.
A narrow canal borders a broad stone promenade that bends between buildings into a tighter passage.
The second plaza is raised on broad shallow steps, with pedestrian lanes continuing around its edges.
Small arched bridges and pale parapets connect passages through the surrounding building gaps.
Pale stone coping defines the canal boundary, while rectangular paving courses distinguish walks and steps.
Warm beige paving and reddish side-lane surfaces contrast with dark teal water and subtle reflections.

targets.label: Canal, stepped plazas and connecting routes

features.criterion: Narrow cream, ochre and blush buildings enclose the plazas with varied heights and terracotta rooflines.
An ochre towerlike facade beside the planted plaza connects to its neighbor through an elevated enclosed span over an arched passage.
Paired pointed or scalloped window arches, small balconies and horizontal stone bands distinguish the plaza's surrounding facades.
Receding canal-side buildings retain shutters, awnings, tiled roofs and pale window trim at smaller apparent scale.
Light plaster, restrained exposed brick and pale stone trim give neighboring buildings distinct but coordinated surfaces.

targets.label: Surrounding palazzi and elevated architectural connection

features.criterion: A slender bell tower rises well above the canal-side rooftops, terminating in a steep pyramidal spire.
The brick shaft supports a pale framed belfry with repeated arched openings and stacked projecting cornices.
Warm red masonry contrasts with pale stone detailing and a muted green spire.
A tall facade closely bounds the right side of the canal promenade, with a recessed ground-level doorway.
Heavy pale stone framing outlines the doorway, building corner and division between upper and lower facade.
The lower wall carries saturated blue panels with a repeating gold diagonal lattice pattern.
The upper facade has a warm cream-and-salmon geometric surface and projecting dark window surrounds.
An ornate low stone wellhead occupies the canal promenade, with a broad circular rim, faceted body and stepped base.
Large square stone planters frame the plaza steps around a leafy tree in a low polygonal planting bed.
Blue-and-white striped mooring posts mark the shop-side canal edge, while a pale bench sits against the blue facade.
Pale carved stone furnishings contrast with dense green shrubs, trailing ivy and small pink-purple flowers.
